{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study reanalyzes data from a previous systematic review to compare treatment effects between animal experiments and clinical trials for six interventions, explicitly measuring concordance. It reports concordance rates (e.g., 'two interventions (bisphosphonates, thrombolytics) were concordant... one intervention was partially concordant... and three were discordant').",
  "arm": "efficacy",
  "arm_evidence": "Our aims were to reanalyse Perel et al’s data to i. explore the actual harms to animals involved in the studies and to assess these against the actual benefits for humans accruing from these studies; and ii. test the feasibility of the retrospective HBA method.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "cardiovascular",
    "neurology-stroke",
    "musculoskeletal",
    "respiratory"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Perel et al[ 22 ] identified 6 interventions for which there was unambiguous systematic review evidence of a treatment effect for humans: corticosteroids for brain injury, antenatal corticosteroids for neonatal respiratory distress, bisphosphonates for osteoporosis, antifibrinolytics for haemorrhage, thrombolytics for stroke and Tirilazad for stroke.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The studies involved an estimated 27,149 animals, including rats, mice, guinea pigs, rabbits, pigs, non-human primates (baboons, monkeys, squirrel monkeys), cats, sheep and cows. All studies used animals as models of human conditions, rather than for regulatory purposes.",
  "species": [
    "rat",
    "mouse",
    "guinea-pig",
    "rabbit",
    "pig",
    "non-human-primate",
    "cat",
    "sheep",
    "cattle"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The studies involved an estimated 27,149 animals, including rats, mice, guinea pigs, rabbits, pigs, non-human primates (baboons, monkeys, squirrel monkeys), cats, sheep and cows.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "Concordance between animal and human studies suggests that the animal studies represent or model the human condition adequately[ 22 ], and ii. current clinical practice relating to the 6 interventions."
}
